description: Na₃CoO₃ crystallizes in the cubic P2_13 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.39 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. There are three shorter (2.34 Å) and three longer (2.87 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.26 Å. Co is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Co-O bond lengths are 1.78 Å. O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Co atom.
